assetGroups.$comment: The whole application, not just a shell. Every lazy route chunk is prefetched on install, because 'works offline' has to mean every screen and not only the ones visited while online: somebody who logs workouts at the gym may never have opened Progress on a connection.
assetGroups.name: app

assetGroups.$comment: Icons and both font families. The Arabic faces are not optional: without them a user reading the app in Arabic offline falls back to a system font, which changes every line's metrics.
assetGroups.name: branding

assetGroups.$comment: Optional illustration packs: fetched on first use, then kept current. These are the only assets a user might never need.
assetGroups.name: illustrations

$commentDataGroups: Deliberately empty. Version 1 makes no network requests at all — the exercise catalog and the translations are build output, not an API — so there is no response caching to configure. Anything added here would be caching a server that does not exist.
$commentNavigationUrls: Matched within the service worker's scope, which is the base href, so this stays correct when the app is served from a repository subpath. The exclusions keep anything with a file extension from being served index.html.
